headline: One picture, 3 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 3 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 3 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.002 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 60b7d3b6a5cd on 2 works, fe96b23bb71e on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Other (2), Village Pond (1).
All 3 works report the same GPS point (26.521131, 78.415992).
The entries were made by 2 different offices: Sub Engineer, Sub engineer.
